subject: Q2 leadership pack: roadmap snapshot, timeline, and risk register
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:06:00-07:00
Subject: Q2 leadership pack prep: need consolidated roadmap snapshot and top-5 risks

Team —

As we finalize the Q2 leadership pack for next week's exec review, I need a short, consolidated snapshot of: 1) product/engineering roadmap status across the five prioritized launches; 2) an updated launch timeline/Gantt we can include in the deck; and 3) a prioritized risk register (top 5) with owners and mitigation status.

Could each of you own the sections aligned to your teams and send updates by EOD Tuesday so I can synthesize? Suggested owners:
- Soojin: compile roadmap status and callouts for cross-team dependencies
- Laura: timeline/Gantt and external launch gating (compliance/procurement)
- Marcus: delivery risks and mitigations (infra + runtime)

I've attached the interim worksheet (roadmap_snapshot_Q2_v1.xlsx) and a blank risk register. If you prefer, drop comments directly on the Drive deck link below.

Thanks — keep entries concise (1–2 bullets per item) so we can fit the executive slide.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
VP Product, Redwood Inference

Attachments: roadmap_snapshot_Q2_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB); risk_register_template.csv (csv, 4KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Q2 leadership pack prep: need consolidated roadmap snapshot and top-5 risks

Thanks Aditya — taking point on the roadmap compile. Quick notes / ask from my side:

1) Status format: I'll use three columns per launch — committed scope, 2-week health (green/amber/red), and remaining open blockers (owner + ETA).
2) Dependencies: please flag any external partner gating (e.g., marketplace listing, third-party infra cert) in one line so I can surface them separately.
3) Data: I'll pull the latest burndown and CI pass rates; if engineering leads have specific perf regressions flagged, include them inline.

I've started filling the attached Gantt (launch_timeline_gantt.png) for a suggested publish cadence. High-level concerns I see today:
- L1: Model quantization pilot still at 70% test coverage; blocker is a kernel mismatch that could add 2–3 weeks if not resolved (owner: Marcus).
- L3: Private deployment onboarding has two outstanding SOC2 evidence items from legal — affects customer launch (owner: Laura).
- Cross-cutting: infra autoscaling playbook needs a validated smoke test tied to canary policy (owner: Vivek).

I will email a draft slide set by EOD Tuesday for review.

-Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: launch_timeline_gantt.png (image, 220KB)

Adding a quick risk note from infra/devops:

- Quantization kernel mismatch (L1): ongoing investigations suggest two remediation paths — backport a compatibility shim (safe, +2 weeks) or recompile kernels under new toolchain (riskier, +4–5 weeks). I've opened RISK-294 and assigned engineers; mitigation is to start the shim pathway now while we prototype the compile path.
- Autoscale smoke test: PR for smoke-runner is in review (PR#782), target merge Thursday. Without this validated test we can't sign the SLA automation for Dedicated customers.

I'll drop short bullets into the risk_register_master.csv and tag owners. If we want, I can also include a short runbook excerpt for the exec slide (1–2 bullets).

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Sr Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime

Attachments: risk_register_master.csv (csv, 6KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Q2 leadership pack: compiled snapshot + exec summary (final draft)

Folks — final pack attached (drive link below) and a 1-slide exec summary pasted beneath. I consolidated the five launches into a single table (status + top risk) and prioritized the top-5 cross-team mitigations. Highlights:

- Overall go/no-go posture: 3 launches on track (green), 2 launches amber with conditional gating (quantization pilot; private-deploy compliance).
- Near-term time impact: quantization kernel mismatch is the only risk with a potential >2 week slip if the shim path fails. We've provisionally scheduled an engineering slack sprint to validate the shim by 04/30.
- Business impact: one enterprise customer (Acme Retail) has a hard launch dependency on SOC2 evidence; procurement/legal are engaged and expect clearance before May 6.

Action items for the exec review (short bullets):
1) Approve contingency runway: authorize a 2-week dev buffer for L1 quantization remediation if needed.
2) Allocate a short-term contractor (1 FTE, infra) to accelerate the smoke-test and canary validation.
3) Confirm stakeholder message for Acme Retail (Laura to draft).

Drive deck (final): https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/Q2-leadership-pack-2027
Doc link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/Q2-leadership-pack-2027/exec_summary_final.pdf

-Soojin
Soojin Lee
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
